approved_findings: Both same-URL captures describe the web Payment Method Messaging Element as localized BNPL plan messaging for product, cart, and payment pages. The rendered plans depend on customer location, currency, and amount; only pay-now options or a countryCode/currency combination without eligible plans produce no message (new raw:7-9,93-101,169; old raw:6-8,98-106,180). The page describes messaging, not payment authorization or a completed financing application.

Both captures show plain Stripe.js and React Stripe.js mounting with a publishable key, amount, currency, and optional countryCode in examples (new raw:17-79; old raw:16-84). The changed script path from js.stripe.com/dahlia/stripe.js to js.stripe.com/endive/stripe.js is a versioned example-path change (diff:7-12), not evidence of a new runtime rule or migration requirement.

For Connect direct charges, the platform must identify the connected account rendering the element by setting stripeAccount on the Stripe instance before element creation (new raw:83-91; old raw:88-96). Dynamic payment methods pull Dashboard preferences only if that feature is used; manual paymentMethodTypes remains an alternative and eligibility filtering still applies. Default dynamic ordering can be changed with paymentMethodOrder (new raw:99-146; old raw:104-157).

The info modal still shows a usage overview, per-plan terms summary, and full-terms links; Affirm, Afterpay/Clearpay, and Klarna remain listed, with Klarna limited here to one-time payments (new raw:148-169; old raw:159-180). Appearance options and merchant responsibility for data-use disclosures and BNPL-promotion compliance also persist (new raw:171-208; old raw:182-222).

The diff changes sample JavaScript formatting, list numbering, heading whitespace, the sample Stripe.js release path, an image URL, and an Afterpay/Clearpay documentation anchor; no changed plan eligibility, provider list, Connect account identity, or compliance obligation appears in the two captures (diff:1-241). The changed release path and hyperlinks should be retained as dated navigation/examples, not inferred deprecation of older integrations.
